tools.name: calculate_shipments
tools.description: Calculates several shipments at once, each like calculate_shipment. A failing shipment doesn't stop the others; each failure says why and whether sending it again can help. Set explain to add calculation sheets (first 25 shipments).

tools.name: find_places
tools.description: Finds cities, sea and inland ports, rail and road terminals, inland depots, border crossings and airports by name, UN/LOCODE or IATA code, with coordinates, from an embedded list (GeoNames, UN/LOCODE, OurAirports). Use it to fill a leg's from and to.

tools.name: list_vehicle_types
tools.description: Lists the vehicle types (and their short aliases) with their emission factors: g CO2e per tonne-km tank-to-wheel and well-to-tank, the distance type they are per, source and year, and for trucks the load model's payload (what load_factor 1 means). Optionally the fuels for the fuel method.
